Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

OPENS Ch 9: SONS' DEATH-SEQUENCE one-by-one (vv. 1-10) — the narrative martyrdom-sequence proper that the speeches (Chs 7-8) have prepared. Each son refuses idol-sacrifice; is tortured (burned + dismembered + crushed); dies confessing God. The serial-martyrdom-sequence parallels: 2 MACCABEES 7:1-19 (seven brothers tortured-and-killed serially — tongues cut out + skin removed + dismemberment + fire); 4 MACCABEES 9-12 (the same expanded torture-list); SHEMOT RABBAH on Exodus 15:1 (the rabbinic midrash of the ten martyrs-of-the-kingdom — Asarah Harugei Malkhut); MARTYRDOM OF POLYCARP 1-22 (Christian-era martyrology). Meqabyan's distinctive feature: each son's death-speech includes a SPECIFIC RESURRECTION-AFFIRMATION — paralleling 2 Macc 7:11 ('I had them from heaven; and for his laws I despise them; and from him I hope to receive them again'). The chapter establishes the COMPLETE TRANSACTIONAL-MARTYRDOM-AND-RESURRECTION PATTERN that Meqabyan's anti-sectarian polemic (Ch 14) will invoke as scriptural-proof.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

SOULS-RECEIVED-BY-ANGELS — the martyrdom-completion psychopomp moment (vv. 11-15): angels descend, receive-the-souls of the five sons, carry them to the bosom-of-Abraham-Isaac-Jacob (the triple-patriarch destination, paired with 1 Mq 3:38 + seed 2 Mq 2:22 and 1 Mq 2:22). The verse mirrors 1 Mq 3:38 word-for-word in its essential structure — confirming the COMPOSITIONAL-PARITY between the 1 Mq Ch 3-4 martyrdom-cycle and the 2 Mq Ch 6-9 martyrdom-cycle that Horovitz 1905 identified as the TYPOLOGICAL-DOUBLE-MARTYRDOM structural pattern of the trilogy. Biblical parallels: LUKE 16:22 ('carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom'); APOCALYPSE OF PAUL §§14-18 (soul-at-death narrative); TESTAMENT OF ASHER 6:4-6 (the angelic-psychopomp-of-the-righteous); ACTS OF THOMAS 159-160 (Mygdonia's angelic-translation). The verse closes the chapter with the canonical-EOTC angelic-reception formula and prepares for Ch 10's POST-MORTEM CRIES.
